assertions.title: Validation - amount must be > 0 (client + server)
assertions.reason: Client blocked amount=0 with inline error, and direct API request with amount=0 returned HTTP 400.

steps.action: Open Add Transaction modal and submit with amount=0 (valid title/date/category).
steps.expected: Client-side amount validation error is shown.
steps.observed: Inline message 'Amount must be greater than 0' displayed.

steps.action: Send direct POST /api/transactions with amount=0 via curl and X-User-Id: 1.
steps.observed: HTTP 400 with body {"error":"amount: Amount must be greater than 0"}.

assertions.title: Validation - title must be non-empty (client + server)
assertions.reason: Client blocked whitespace-only title with inline error, and direct API request with blank title returned HTTP 400.

steps.action: Submit Add Transaction form with whitespace title and valid amount/date/category.
steps.expected: Client-side title validation error is shown.

steps.action: Send direct POST /api/transactions with whitespace title via curl and X-User-Id: 1.
steps.observed: HTTP 400 with body {"error":"title: Title must not be blank"}.

assertions.title: Validation - date must be valid
assertions.reason: Submitting without a date produced inline date validation feedback.

steps.action: Submit Add Transaction form with date left empty and other fields valid.

evidence.network: No server call required for this assertion; validation confirmed in UI.

assertions.title: Loading state while fetching transactions
assertions.reason: During in-flight transactions fetch, UI displayed explicit loading indicator.

steps.action: Patch fetch in-page to delay /api/transactions responses and navigate Dashboard -> Transactions.
steps.expected: Visible loading indicator while GET /api/transactions is in flight.
steps.observed: Text 'Loading transactions...' visible before data rendered.

evidence.network: GET /api/transactions intentionally delayed in browser runtime; loading state captured during request.

assertions.title: Client-side validation feedback on forms
assertions.reason: Form showed multiple inline errors simultaneously and all cleared after valid corrections.

steps.action: Submit Add Transaction form with invalid title, amount=0, empty date, and no category.
steps.expected: All relevant validation errors appear together.
steps.observed: Title, amount, date, and category inline errors shown simultaneously.

steps.action: Correct all fields to valid values without closing form.
steps.observed: Validation messages no longer visible after corrections.

evidence.network: UI-only validation behavior verified in form states.

assertions.title: Responsive behavior on narrow screens
assertions.reason: At 375px viewport, transactions UI remained usable and add form was operable.

steps.action: Set viewport to 375x812 and inspect Transactions page layout.
steps.expected: Narrow-screen adaptation keeps transaction UI usable.
steps.observed: Mobile layout rendered with working controls.

steps.action: Open Add Transaction form at 375px viewport.
steps.expected: Form remains usable on narrow screens.
steps.observed: Modal form fields/buttons were accessible and interactable.

assertions.title: Error handling visible in UI
assertions.reason: When transactions fetch failed, UI showed clear user-facing error with retry action.

steps.action: Abort /api/transactions requests using agent-browser network route and load Transactions page.
steps.expected: User-friendly error message is shown (not blank screen/raw exception).
steps.observed: UI displayed 'Failed to load transactions' with a 'Retry' button.

evidence.network: GET /api/transactions -> aborted (simulated failure via route), error state rendered in UI.

frictions.description: Loading indicator was too brief to capture on normal-speed local responses.
frictions.resolution: Temporarily delayed /api/transactions fetch in browser runtime to capture in-flight loading state evidence.
